notes: All 12 rows are in section 7, so no row has a For label and there is no label doubt. No row came with a hint. Facts were derived from the code at commit 7eddde7895. Three statements rest on the documentation of other software and not on Tron code: (1) GNU Make lets an environment value replace the built-in default of `RM` (GNU Make manual, "Variables from the Environment"). (2) cargo uses no wrapper when `RUSTC_WRAPPER` or `RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER` is empty (Cargo reference, "Environment variables Cargo reads"). (3) Nix exports the attribute `shellHook` of a dev shell into the environment of `nix develop -c`; the Tron test depends on this, and it was not measured here. Style differences that this chunk cannot remove, for a later cleanup: the iotools rows of other chunks write the "Defined by" cell in three ways (`iotools`, `iotools makefile`, `iotools 1.5 makefile`), and the `CARGO_BUILD_*` rows of another chunk describe `rust/run-cargo` with a different clause than the five `RUST*` rows here. Rows changed only for house rules (verdict correct): RM (definition of iotools), RUSTC, RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER, RUSTC_WRAPPER, RUSTDOC, RUSTFMT ("No reader in Tron.", definition of cargo, the test files that set the name) and COVERAGE_PROCESS_START ("No reader in Tron.", the sentence about a source comment). One shell command of this work used `cd` into the audit2 output directory to list files; it read nothing inside the checkout and changed nothing.
